items.statement: Investigate what molecular structures and nitrate coordination can be supported for the supplied iridium complex by its composition and reported IR observations. Develop an evidence-based structural interpretation, assess whether it is uniquely identifiable within the molecular model, and state which conclusions remain uncertain. The coordination topology and relative ligand arrangement are research questions, not supplied candidate answers.
items.expected: State the molecular structure information actually supported and whether it is unique at the investigated resolution. Credit a scientifically supported candidate set, source disagreement or bounded ambiguity; no eta2 winner is mandatory. Separate source crystallographic facts from findings inferred from public composition/IR and from newly generated calculations. No credit for claiming ambiguity because research was omitted, or uniqueness because a copied crystal geometry matches its own source. Limit conclusion to the nitrato characterization problem.
